title: Recovery-State Transfer and Semantic Interoperability Across Public Space-Cyber Datasets
scientific_scope: deterministic semantic-interface sufficiency and downstream decision identifiability across independently sourced public space-cyber datasets

research_questions.RQ1: Across preregistered public space-cyber datasets, which recovery decision variables are directly observable, deterministically derivable by a predeclared rule, ambiguous, or absent without using attack labels as operational truth?
research_questions.RQ2: Conditioned only on qualifying dataset-native operationally visible state, when is the downstream recovery action uniquely identifiable versus ambiguous across admissible completions of missing decision state?
research_questions.RQ3: What minimal additional sidecar or interface state is sufficient to make the downstream recovery action uniquely identifiable without imputing unavailable mission, trust, freshness, epoch, contradiction, or authorization semantics?
research_questions.RQ4: Which missing recovery-state semantics are common across independently generated public space-cyber datasets and which are dataset-specific?

dataset_inclusion_criteria: publicly accessible research artifact or dataset with stable source identity
spacecraft, satellite, CubeSat, or satellite-communications cybersecurity relevance established by the primary source
documented telemetry, command, network, system, or security-event schema sufficient for field-level semantic review
version, release, commit, DOI, or equivalent provenance can be recorded before analysis
legal terms permit the intended noncommercial academic analysis and reproducibility record
source population is sufficiently independent from other included primary datasets for cross-source comparison, or dependence is explicitly modeled before inclusion
no operational credential, private mission data, or unauthorized target interaction is required
dataset_exclusion_criteria: schema or provenance cannot be resolved before analysis
artifact is inaccessible or cannot be version-bound
source is only a derivative of an already included testbed population and independence cannot be represented transparently
required use would conflict with license or access conditions
inclusion would require fabricating missing recovery semantics
source provides only narrative attack descriptions with no analyzable security-relevant data interface

dataset_attack_or_scenario_labels_may_be: post hoc explanation of observed semantic coverage after primary endpoints are computed
dataset_attack_or_scenario_labels_may_no: counting security_signal as operationally directly observed
selecting the downstream recovery action in a primary endpoint

missing_state_rule: Unavailable decision state remains unknown. It is not defaulted, inferred from lexical similarity, imputed from attack class, or replaced by analyst expectation.
action_identifiability_rule: For each analyzed native record or losslessly collapsed native-state group, enumerate all downstream recovery actions reachable across every admissible assignment of unresolved required recovery-state variables. An action is uniquely identifiable only when the admissible action set has cardinality one.
minimal_sidecar_rule: For unresolved set U, a candidate sidecar subset S is sufficient if and only if, for every binary assignment to S, revealing that assignment leaves a reachable action set of cardinality one across every assignment to U\S. The canonical endpoint retains every sufficient subset of minimum cardinality and never substitutes unavailable actual values of unresolved state.
analysis_population_rule: Each included dataset is analyzed as its own finite source population. Decision-equivalent native rows may be collapsed losslessly into state groups with exact integer multiplicity, and all row-level denominators are preserved exactly through multiplicity weighting. Datasets are not pooled into a single empirical population for inferential claims.
statistics_rule: Primary reporting uses deterministic finite-population counts, proportions, set intersections, set unions, and exact combinatorial summaries. No p-value, confidence interval, or population-generalization claim is required unless a later protocol amendment introduces an actual sampling model before results are observed.
independence_rule: Shared testbed, simulator, collection campaign, or derived-dataset provenance must be recorded. A derivative source is not counted as an independent testbed population merely because it has a different publication title or preprocessing pipeline.
stopping_rules: dataset selection is frozen before row-level analysis begins
schema manifests and source artifact identities are frozen before semantic mapping is executed
mapping rubric and derivation rules are frozen before inspecting row-level endpoint results
primary policy scope and dataset-by-policy stratification are frozen before real row-level execution
canonical input identity, state-collapse, multiplicity weighting, guaranteed-sidecar, deterministic-output, and independent-audit rules are frozen before real row-level execution
guarded loader/runner implementation is synthetic-tested before any real-data authorization is opened

pre-real-data adversarial audit remediations, including independent raw-row projection and full synthetic runner integration, are implemented and actual-clone tested before any real-data authorization is opened
pre-real-data performance remediation must preserve exhaustive semantics and pass actual-clone validation before the canonical-run code freeze
the exact tested canonical-run code state is separately frozen before the future execution phase may be opened
no candidate is added or removed after endpoint inspection except through a documented protocol deviation that is reported separately and does not rewrite the preregistered primary population
interpretation_guards: Study 9 does not estimate intrusion-detection accuracy, recall, precision, F1, false-positive rate, or false-negative rate unless a later separately preregistered experiment explicitly does so.
Study 9 does not claim detector or classifier transferability merely from semantic interoperability results.
Study 9 does not claim operational spacecraft recovery, mission assurance, flight validation, or on-orbit effectiveness.
Dataset attack labels are not treated as operational alarms in primary endpoints.
Correlation between a native feature and a missing recovery variable is not semantic observability.
A published dataset's construction counts are not attack-prevalence estimates.
Study 5 remains frozen and is not pooled with Study 9.
Submitted Papers 1 through 4 remain frozen and unmodified.
No result may be described as externally validated solely because multiple public datasets were analyzed.
No AI or learned method superiority claim is permitted unless directly measured in a separately authorized experiment.
Primary Study 9 policies are evaluated separately; policy pooling, averaging, interchangeable-replicate treatment, and policy-superiority claims are prohibited.
Unavailable actual values of ambiguous or absent recovery state may not be supplied to the canonical minimal-sidecar endpoint.
Lossless native-state collapse is an exact computational equivalence with multiplicity preservation, not sampling, deduplication, or row exclusion.
Loader/runner implementation does not itself authorize real source access; authorization is checked before any user-supplied dataset path is inspected.
The independent audit must reconstruct raw-row projection and policy-independent coverage without calling the canonical projector or canonical mapping implementation.
Canonical result provenance must bind the exact governance and runtime implementation files by SHA-256 in run_manifest.json.
Real execution authorization must transition atomically; piecemeal flag changes are invalid.
Selector memoization may eliminate repeated deterministic computation only; it may not prune, sample, approximate, or otherwise alter the exhaustive completion or guaranteed-sidecar semantics.
The canonical-run code freeze binds the actual-clone-tested computational runtime only; it does not freeze scientific results and does not authorize real-data access or execution.

primary_population_freeze.membership_change_rule: After this freeze, adding or removing a primary population requires a documented protocol deviation and must not rewrite the frozen primary-population record retroactively.

direct_operational_native_exception.claim_boundary: Operational coarse position-spoofing guard only; not attack truth or detector-performance evidence.

semantic_adjudication_freeze.change_rule: After this freeze, changing target semantics, mapping classes, eligible fields, exclusions, or derivation rules requires a documented protocol deviation and must not rewrite the frozen semantic-adjudication record retroactively after endpoint inspection.

policy_scope_freeze.change_rule: After this freeze, changing the primary policy set, policy order, ablation exclusion, stratification rule, or endpoint policy scope requires a documented prospective protocol deviation and must not rewrite the frozen policy-scope record retroactively after real endpoint inspection.

canonical_execution_design_freeze.change_rule: After this freeze, changing input identities, state construction, collapse equivalence, multiplicity weighting, admissible completion semantics, guaranteed-sidecar semantics, endpoint stratification, label boundaries, deterministic output requirements, or independent-audit requirements requires a documented prospective protocol deviation and must not rewrite the frozen execution-design record retroactively after real endpoint inspection.

canonical_run_code_freeze.change_rule: Any frozen computational byte change requires a new prospective code freeze and complete actual-clone validation before canonical real-data execution may be authorized.

canonical_execution_authorization_record.authorization_basis: successful final pre-real-data actual-clone validation and explicit author authorization

implementation_phase.policy_scope_rule: The four frozen substantive Study 2 policies are primary and must be evaluated separately. The four NO_* policies remain excluded mechanistic ablations. The implementation must not encode a canonical default policy.
implementation_phase.execution_design_rule: Canonical real-data execution must use hash-verified inputs, frozen state construction, lossless state collapse with exact multiplicity, full admissible completion enumeration, the guaranteed minimal-sidecar endpoint without actual missing values, deterministic outputs, and an independently implemented audit. Real-data execution is authorized only under this atomic phase transition and the frozen code identity.
implementation_phase.loader_runner_rule: Real canonical execution may use only explicitly supplied external dataset paths under the open execution phase. run_canonical_sources must validate authorization before constructing external source specs, verify frozen source identities before analysis, and keep dataset bytes outside the repository.
implementation_phase.pre_real_data_hardening_rule: The independent audit must reconstruct raw-row projection and policy-independent mapping/coverage separately from canonical implementations; the full post-guard pipeline must be synthetic-tested end-to-end; run_manifest.json must bind exact governance/runtime SHA-256 identities; and the future real-execution transition must be atomic and preceded by a canonical-run code freeze.
implementation_phase.pre_real_data_performance_rule: Repeated frozen-contract and deterministic selector work may be memoized separately within the canonical and independent paths, but exhaustive admissible-completion and guaranteed-sidecar enumeration must remain exact and unchanged.
implementation_phase.canonical_run_code_freeze_rule: The exact actual-clone-tested computational runtime is frozen by SHA-256 and byte size before real-data authorization; contracts.py validates the freeze but is not part of its own self-referential computational hash set.
